Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

The ceilings will further rise by 25 per cent each time DA increases by - Resoln. No. 11-1/2016-IC, dated 6-7-2017 and Order (15).  
50 per cent.  
NOTE.Same station means, where the person was on duty before proceeding on deputation and where there is no change in the Headquarters with reference to the last post held and places falling within the same urban agglomeration of the old Headquarters.
